name: The Lookout
address: Hill St, Lookout Beach, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Beachfront venue serving cocktails and crowd-pleasers with unbeatable views over Lookout Beach and the Indian Ocean.
description_long:
Perched right on Lookout Beach, this popular spot draws locals and visitors alike with its front-row seats to one of Plett's most beautiful stretches of coastline. The sprawling deck and relaxed atmosphere make it ideal for long lunches, sundowners, or casual dinners where the crashing waves provide the soundtrack.

The menu covers all the bases with pizzas, burgers, grills, and seafood options that won't disappoint after a day on the beach. The cocktail bar keeps things lively, especially during sunset when the deck fills up. It's the kind of place where you can rock up in your beach gear or settle in for a proper meal—the vibe works either way.

With its prime position on Hill Street and easy beach access, The Lookout has become a Plett institution. Families appreciate the relaxed approach to kids, and the generous portions mean everyone leaves satisfied. Come for the views, stay for the buzz—this is beachfront dining done right.
